liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Salty Sheep** (2 reviews): Listener says Salty Sheep is track eleven on this 16-bit copy; Listener says track eleven is actually 'Give Me Back My 15 Cents', which they believe is a Doc Watson tune [6][7]
- **Slipstream** (1 review): Listener identifies the track labeled as an instrumental as Slipstream, which appears in an original version on Bela Fleck's album Drive [4]
- **June Apple** (1 review): Listener says June Apple is the second track on this 16-bit copy [6]

## Setlist highlights

- **Deep Blue Sea**: mythic rare: 2 archived performances [8]
- **GBOTT**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [8]
- **Steam Powered Aeroplane**: rare: 10 archived performances [8]

## The recordings

- **BillyStrings2018-05-26.CA11Omnis.Flac24** (recommended): source not stated; 16 songs; 100 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [1]
- **BillyStrings2018-05-26.CA11Omnis.Latenight.Flac16**: source not stated; 15 songs; 100 min [2]
- **BillyStrings2018-05-26.CA11Omnis.Flac16**: source not stated; 15 songs; 73 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [3]

## Around the show

- Stage talk about: Pyramid Country [1]
- Listener felt Billy and Bryan were more absorbed in the music than in the audience, and their playing stood out [7]
- Late-night Music Hall set running from 2 AM to 3:30 AM, with Ronnie McCoury on mandolin and Zebulon Bowles on fiddle [1]
- Late-night Music Hall set from 2 AM to 3:30 AM, with Ronnie McCoury guesting on mandolin [2]

## Tapers and lineage

- **BillyStrings2018-05-26.CA11Omnis.Flac24**: taped by Rich Stoler; transferred by Rich Stoler; source: CA-11 Omnis > CA 9200 PowerAmp > TASCAM DR-100mkII (24/48) [1]. Also: Church Audio CA-11 Omni mics into a CA 9200 preamp, recorded on a TASCAM DR-100mkII at 24-bit/48 kHz [1]
- **BillyStrings2018-05-26.CA11Omnis.Latenight.Flac16**: taped by Rich Stoler; transferred by Rich Stoler; source: CA-11 Omnis > CA 9200 PowerAmp > TASCAM DR-100mkII (24/48) [2]. Also: Church Audio CA-11 Omnis into a CA 9200 preamp and TASCAM DR-100mkII, recorded at 24-bit/48 kHz [2]
- **BillyStrings2018-05-26.CA11Omnis.Flac16**: taped by Rich Stoler; transferred by Rich Stoler; source: CA-11 Omnis > CA 9200 PowerAmp > TASCAM DR-100mkII (24/48) [3]. Also: Church Audio CA-11 Omnis into a CA 9200 preamp and TASCAM DR-100mkII, recorded at 24-bit/48 kHz; SD card to Audacity (dithered to 16-bit), then CDWAV tracking and FLAC conversion [3]
